name: IRF540N
source: Infineon IRF540NPbF データシート (Rev. 2.1, 2026-07-24)
description: N チャネル パワーMOSFET 100V 33A (TO-220, ピン1=G 2=D 3=S)。10V 駆動。データシート (Infineon) の代表特性から作った等価モデル (レベル1 + 直列抵抗、ボディダイオードつき)

transfer.at: 図 3 (伝達特性の代表特性、VDS = 50 V) の 25 °C

body_diode.at: 図 7 (ソース・ドレイン間ダイオードの順方向の代表特性) の 25 °C

remarks: the table gives VGS(th) min 2.0 / max 4.0 V and RDS(on) max 44 mohm (10 V, 16 A) only; the typical values are the graphs'. Most tick labels on the graph pages are pictures, so the axes were placed on the grid lines found with `ds grid` (the thick ones are the decades) and read with `ds trace` with `xt=` / `yt=`

transfer: Figure 3 (VDS = 50 V), the 25 C curve (the steeper of the two; it crosses the 175 C one near 5.3 V). Its square root rises 3.8 per volt at 5 V and 1.8 at 7 V: RS is fitted (the source resistance in the gate loop)

rds: Figure 1 (25 C) in its linear part: the top bundle (7 to 15 V, which lie on each other there) at 0.3 V and 1 V (7.3 A, 26.4 A: 41 and 38 mohm) taken as VGS = 10 V; the 4.5 V curve at 0.3 V (4.28 A: 70 mohm)
caps: the table's Ciss 1960, Coss 250, Crss 40 pF typ (VGS = 0, VDS = 25 V, 1 MHz)
body_diode: Figure 7, the 25 C curve (the right one), 0.2 to 50 A; the table's VSD max 1.2 V at 16 A
